title: Search results disappear after changing folders
description: After selecting a different workspace folder, search returns no matches even for files that are present. Returning to the original folder restores results. Expected search to refresh for the selected folder.

title: Application freezes when saving a large file
description: Saving a file larger than about 20 MB makes the editor stop responding for several minutes. The save eventually fails and recent edits are lost. Expected the save to complete or report an error while keeping the editor responsive.

title: Duplicate notifications are sent for one event
description: A user receives two identical email notifications whenever a comment is added to a ticket. The activity log shows only one comment. Expected one notification per comment event.

title: Password reset link is rejected before it expires
description: The password reset link displays an expired-link error within a minute of being issued. Requesting another link sometimes works, but the original link is still within its stated validity period. Expected the link to remain usable until its expiration time.

title: CSV export drops rows containing commas
description: Exporting a table to CSV truncates fields and shifts columns when a value contains a comma. Opening the exported file shows incorrect cell boundaries. Expected values containing commas to be quoted and preserved.

title: Timezone setting shifts scheduled jobs by one hour
description: After daylight-saving time changes, scheduled jobs run one hour earlier than the configured time. The displayed schedule still shows the configured hour. Expected jobs to run at the selected local time.

title: Uploading a profile image returns success but keeps the old image
description: The upload dialog reports success for a new profile image, but refreshing the page still shows the previous image. The new image is not visible on the profile. Expected the uploaded image to replace the existing one.

title: Pagination repeats the last item from the previous page
description: When moving from one results page to the next, the first row on the new page duplicates the last row from the previous page and another result is missing. Expected each result to appear exactly once across pages.

title: Session expires while the user is actively editing
description: A user typing in a form is redirected to the sign-in page after a short idle timer, even though keyboard input continues. Unsaved form contents are lost. Expected active editing to keep the session alive or preserve the draft.

title: Retrying a failed payment creates two charges
description: After a payment request times out, retrying it creates a second charge even though the first charge appears in the payment provider history. Expected retries to be idempotent and create at most one charge.
